facts.text: The README describes the repository as a simulation environment for the Unitree GO1 robot in Gazebo 11 and ROS 2, tested with ROS Humble on Ubuntu 22.04.
The README starts go1_gazebo, then unitree_guide2 junior_ctrl; the operator presses 2 for fixed_stand and 5 for move_base mode, in which the robot accepts velocity commands.
The README declares the velocity control interface on the absolute /cmd_vel topic with geometry_msgs/Twist.
The README declares odometry on the absolute /odom topic with nav_msgs/Odometry from the ground-truth plugin.
The README declares 2D LiDAR data on the absolute /scan topic with sensor_msgs/LaserScan from the Gazebo sensor plugin.
The README declares transforms on the absolute /tf topic with tf2_msgs/TFMessage.
The ROS 2 State_move_base constructor creates the state_mb node and calls initRecv().
State_move_base::getUserCmd calls setHighCmd with the _vx, _vy and _wz values received from the Twist callback.
State_move_base::twistCallback copies msg->linear.x, msg->linear.y and msg->angular.z into _vx, _vy and _wz.
State_move_base::initRecv creates a subscription for geometry_msgs::msg::Twist on the absolute /cmd_vel topic with queue depth 1.
State_Trotting::setHighCmd writes vx and vy into _vCmdBody and wz into _dYawCmd directly; it does not clamp them.
The Go1Robot constructor sets _robVelLimitX to -0.4..0.4, _robVelLimitY to -0.3..0.3 and _robVelLimitYaw to -0.5..0.5.

The Gazebo ray sensor is configured for 450 samples over 0.0..6.28319 rad, range 0.4..35.0 m and update_rate 30; its plugin remaps ~/out to scan, outputs sensor_msgs/LaserScan and uses frame_name laser_link.
The p3d ground-truth plugin tracks body_name base_link, publishes topic_name odom in frame_name odom and updates at 100 Hz.
The ROS 2 Estimator creates a node named estimator, a publisher for nav_msgs::msg::Odometry on odom and a tf2_ros TransformBroadcaster.
Estimator::run fills the odometry message and the odom transform in its ROS 2 block, but the sendTransform and publish calls are commented out.
KeyBoard::checkCmd maps key 1 to UserCommand::L2_B (passive) and key 5 to UserCommand::L2_Y (move_base).
State_Passive::enter sets mode 10, zero q, dq and tau, Kp 0 and Kd 8 for the Gazebo platform, and its checkChange returns PASSIVE unless the user command is L2_A.
FSM::run calls ioInter->setPassive() when checkSafty() returns false.
IOROS::RosShutDown(int sig) prints a shutdown message and calls rclcpp::shutdown().
main.cpp's ShutDown(int sig) prints 'stop the controller' and sets the running flag to false.
IOROS::initSend creates twelve MotorCmd publishers on the per-leg controller command topics, and initRecv subscribes twelve MotorState topics and /imu_plugin/out.
unitree_guide2's CMakeLists sets CATKIN_MAKE ON, SIMULATION ON, REAL_ROBOT OFF and MOVE_BASE ON, and sets ROS_2 only when CATKIN_MAKE, SIMULATION and MOVE_BASE are all on.
CMake stops with an error when SIMULATION and REAL_ROBOT are both on or both off.
ROS_2 adds the COMPILE_WITH_ROS2_MB definition.
main constructs IOROS for the Gazebo platform under COMPILE_WITH_SIMULATION and IOSDK for the real robot under COMPILE_WITH_REAL_ROBOT.
For ROBOT_TYPE_Go1 the IOSDK constructor builds its unitree_legged_sdk safety object as LeggedType::Aliengo and its UDP object with LOWLEVEL, 8090, 192.168.123.10 and 8007.
navigation.launch.py starts Nav2's controller_server with cmd_vel remapped to cmd_vel.
start_world.launch.py includes gazebo_ros's gazebo.launch.py.
junior_ctrl's main loop calls ControlFrame::run until SIGINT clears the running flag.
FSM::run exchanges commands and states, runs the estimator and the current state, and waits for the rest of its period on the system clock.
State_move_base is a State_Trotting whose checkChange goes to PASSIVE on L2_B and to FIXEDSTAND on L2_A.
The trotting state starts the gait wave when checkStepOrNot is true and sets all four legs to stance otherwise.
checkStepOrNot is true when the commanded x or y velocity exceeds 0.03, a position error exceeds 0.08, a velocity error exceeds 0.05 or the yaw-rate command exceeds 0.20.
KeyBoard::checkCmd maps key 2 to UserCommand::L2_A (fixed stand).
gzserver.launch.py adds the init and factory gazebo_ros system plugins to the server command.
gzserver.launch.py defaults its init and factory arguments to true.
The init plugin takes the shared gazebo_ros node from gazebo_ros::Node::Get().
gazebo_ros::Node::Get creates the shared node named gazebo with an empty namespace.
The gazebo_ros executor spins its nodes on a thread of its own.
The init plugin creates the pause_physics and unpause_physics services with the std_srvs::srv::Empty type.
OnPause calls world_->SetPaused(true).
OnUnpause calls world_->SetPaused(false).
The init plugin publishes the simulation clock from a world-update-begin callback.
The factory plugin creates the get_model_list service with the gazebo_msgs::srv::GetModelList type.
GetModelList sets header.stamp to the world's simulation time, lists the model names and sets success true.
The GetModelList response documents header.stamp as the simulation time when the data was collected.
World::Step advances simulation time and calls Update only when the world is not paused, a step increment is pending or a reset is due; otherwise it adds the step to the pause time.
World::Step holds worldUpdateMutex while it steps the world.
World::SetPaused stores the paused flag under worldUpdateMutex.
World::IsPaused returns the stored paused flag.
World::Update fires the worldUpdateBegin event and then updates every model.
World::Step calls ProcessMessages after the paused or unpaused branch, so pending messages are processed on every step, paused or not.
A WorldControl message with step calls OnStep, and one with multi_step pauses the world and sets the number of steps to run while paused.
gazebo_ros2_control spins its controller manager's executor on a thread of its own.
gazebo_ros2_control connects its Update to the world-update begin event.
gazebo_ros2_control's Update reads the simulation time, updates the controllers and writes their commands to the joints.

determinism.notes: Event-driven rosbridge fake with no physics step, ray sensor, state integration or wall-clock pacing; placeholder observations do not establish trajectory or state-hash replay

gaps: the fake is a ROS-free rosbridge contract stand-in, not a recording of captured traffic: it runs no Gazebo physics, ray sensor, p3d ground-truth plugin, estimator node or ROS graph
the /odom pose and orientation are placeholders; the /odom twist echoes the last published Twist only as a contract effect and is not an integrated motion state
the fake returns three placeholder LaserScan ranges; the pinned ray plugin is configured for 450 samples over 0.0..6.28319 rad at 30 Hz (go1_sim/go1_description/xacro/robot.xacro:185-217)
the /scan range values, scan_time and time_increment are placeholders, not ray-cast measurements or sensor timing

the clone exposes no acknowledged ROS stop, pause or reset service or action, and a zero-Twist publication remains transmission-only; the stop is the companion gazebo_ros world pause, confirmed by the E1 stall read-back: the fake keeps a paused flag that /pause_physics sets and a sim-time stamp that /get_model_list reports and that advances on every answer unless paused; it runs no Gazebo World::Step

a frozen get_model_list stamp is also what a hung but unpaused gzserver shows (nothing advances then either); a GUI step or a WorldControl multi_step between the two samples fails the check (fails closed); the e-stop declares estop_latency_ms 1500 because the pause (400 ms), two read-backs (300 ms each) and the 250 ms interval exceed the default 1000 ms budget

no unpause is offered: a zero Twist clears move_base's stored velocity (State_move_base.cpp:81-85), but junior_ctrl's loop keeps running on the wall clock through the pause (main.cpp:106-110, FSM.cpp:38-66) on stale joint and IMU states, and the trotting state steps whenever an error exceeds its thresholds (State_Trotting.cpp:95-99, 115-127), so the stored command does not alone decide what the legs do on an unpause; the operator recovers outside MHS (junior_ctrl key 2 for fixed_stand or stopping junior_ctrl, then the Gazebo GUI play button or ros2 service call /unpause_physics)

while paused, /odom (p3d plugin), /scan (ray sensor) and /clock come only from world updates, so they are silent and the odometry and scan reads fail NOT_READY after their timeouts (the fake silences them while its flag is set); the device resource reads no topic, so commands and resets do not wait for them, and the cmd_vel receipt reports the values it sent

a live world can be unpaused or stepped by the Gazebo GUI, a WorldControl message or any ROS 2 client of /unpause_physics; MHS does not watch the sim time after the e-stop (safety_status re-reads it only on request)
the deployment's gazebo_ros, gazebo_ros2_control and Gazebo must be the pinned 3.9.0, 0.4.12 and 11.15.1 releases the companion citations name; rosbridge cannot read their versions
the /cmd_vel interface acts only in move_base mode; the fake does not model the state machine and the driver has no ROS observation of the active FSM mode
/tf, /imu_plugin/out, the twelve MotorCmd/MotorState controller topics and the internal state machine are not exposed by this package
a live run requires the operator's ROS 2 Humble, Gazebo 11, go1_sim launch, junior_ctrl in move_base mode and rosbridge; none of them is started or validated here
the bridge refuses non-finite numbers, so a scan whose ranges contain inf or NaN (for example a beam without a return) fails the read without output instead of being served as data
/odom comes only from the p3d ground-truth plugin at 100 Hz: the estimator's publish call is commented out (Estimator.cpp:269)

go1_navigation's navigation.launch.py starts Nav2's servers with cmd_vel remapped to cmd_vel (default robot_namespace empty, so /cmd_vel); Nav2's controller publishes velocity setpoints there while navigating and overrides this package's setpoints

the clone also holds the real-robot UDP interface IOSDK (main.cpp:73-76, IOSDK.cpp:10-14), but the move_base /cmd_vel state is compiled only in simulation builds (CMakeLists.txt:17-19, 40-42, 71-73) and the unitree_legged_sdk library it links is not in the clone

safe_state.description: The Gazebo world is paused: two get_model_list answers 250 ms apart carried the same sim time, so no world update runs and gazebo_ros2_control writes no leg command; it is a frozen sim time, not a measured standstill. No unpause is offered: an operator puts junior_ctrl in fixed_stand (key 2) or stops it, then unpauses outside MHS.
